_comment: Shared cases for the size-from-seed rule (STORY-608). Both implementations read this file:
If one side changes behaviour, both suites fail — that is the point. A preview that
disagrees with what the gateway does is worse than no preview at all.
The rule: shape comes from the seed, resolution comes from the request. Rank the offered
sizes by log-aspect distance from the seed, keep everything within `tolerance` of the
best, then pick whichever of those is closest in pixel count to the requested size.
